name: เย็นชา · เบื่อโลก
description: Emotionless detached bored expression: half-lidded narrow eyes, clearly visible small muted grey-violet irises and pale eye whites beneath low straight upper eyelids. Relaxed almost-horizontal fine brows, not angry V-shaped brows. Small flat closed mouth, no smile, no blush, no tears, no dramatic dark under-eye patches. Calm deadpan gaze, not sleepy closed eyes or sadness. Keep separate readable eyes, no black eye band and no sunglasses.
